APPROVE

The extracted loop moves verbatim, including the CHA0004 pragma scope, `ConfigureAwait`, and the `continue` semantics, and it carries the nested try/catch, foreach and if/`||` increments (about 9 of the 17 points) out of `CollectAsync`, leaving it at roughly 8. The one thing I couldn't confirm from the diff alone is that `lockfiles` is a `List<string>`, which the new parameter type assumes; the author presumably matched it.
